element.name: Wildshard's Macabre Projection
element.supports: Bard, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard, Spell Saving Throw

description.p: You tear open a rift in space-time, and a sensor appears within it that projects a creature's deepest fears. Choose a creature you can see within range. Undead and constructs are unaffected by this spell.

The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 5d8 psychic damage and is frightened for the duration. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage, isn't frightened, and the spell ends. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.

setters.set: a broken piece of glass and sand

element.name: Dethrone
element.supports: Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard, Spell Saving Throw

description.p: You use dark magic to reap the life force of your enemy. Choose a creature you can see within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. It takes 10d6 + 20 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
At Higher Levels. Casting this spell using a higher-level spell slot grants no additional benefit.
